sloka: स शापः केकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत् प्रभो ।। ६.१२२.२६ ।।
transliteration: sa śāpaḥ kekayīṁ ghoraḥ saputrāṁ na spṛśet prabho ।। 6.122.26 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord! You had spoken in such a way saying 'I disown a good son and Kaikeyi' and cursed. May that dreadful curse not touch your son and Kaikeyi," said Rama.
